title: Verify: Approve and retry action unit tests
summary: Mocked-fetch tests for approve, retry and conflicts
description: Unit tests for the action buttons with stubbed fetch.
acceptance_criteria: Approve click sends the POST request for the Retry action too: Retry POST is covered by its own test
A 409 message is shown in an alert

steps.action: Tests rendering ExecutionPanel with executionFixture overridden status: 'AWAITING_APPROVAL' shows Approve and click calls onApprove with the id; 'FAILED' shows Retry and click calls onRetry; 'RUNNING' shows neither; actionError 'execution: illegal state' renders in role alert; plus a client test stubbing fetch asserting approveExecution('t','EX1') POSTs /api/v1/admin/executions/EX1/approve with Authorization 'Bearer t' and retryExecution hits /retry
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/actions.test.tsx
